nodes.title: SEO Performance and Polish
nodes.description: Final pre-launch pass: Next.js metadata on all pages, OG image, Next.js Image optimization, jersey photos added, Lighthouse score >= 85 mobile, axe accessibility audit, zero TypeScript/ESLint errors.
acceptanceCriteria: Every page has unique title and meta description
OG image set on homepage
Lighthouse Performance >= 85 on mobile
Lighthouse Accessibility >= 90 on all public pages
TypeScript compiles clean with zero errors
nodes.humanQuestion: Wait for the OK from human before starting task

nodes.title: User Sync Architecture Revisit
nodes.description: Revisit the client-side query+mutation pattern for syncing Clerk users into Convex. Current approach runs a Convex query on every page load for authenticated users. Evaluate: Clerk webhook handled entirely as a Convex HTTP action, or a Convex auth trigger, to guarantee sync fires exactly once on sign-up with no client-side overhead.
acceptanceCriteria: Sync fires exactly once on user creation with no per-page-load queries
No unauthenticated mutations callable from outside the system
Solution works in local dev without ngrok or manual steps
Existing users table data preserved

nodes.title: Consolidate Order Design Intake Validation Rules
nodes.description: Apply the A-03 split to lib/order.ts, lib/design.ts, and lib/intake.ts. Convex orders.ts, designs.ts, and intakes.ts import constants and checks from the new rules modules. Single source for team-name, sport, quantity, design title, and brief caps.
acceptanceCriteria: rules.ts plus form.ts split done for order, design, and intake lib modules
convex/orders.ts, designs.ts, intakes.ts import constants from new rules modules
no duplicated validation constants remain across lib and convex
all existing tests pass
A-02 smoke tests still pass
nodes.humanQuestion: Hold off until we finalize order UI

nodes.title: Extract Form Hooks From Large Components
nodes.description: Optional and deferred. Extract use*Form hooks (state, validation glue, payload building, submission status) out of JerseyRunSetup (686 lines), IntakeForm (678), JerseyRunPublicForm (594), DesignForm (589), and OrderForm (544). Only worth doing if the files still feel unwieldy after A-03..A-05 land - re-measure first.
acceptanceCriteria: after A-03..A-05 land, re-measure line counts for each form component and confirm extraction is still worth doing
if confirmed, useJerseyRunForm, useIntakeForm, useJerseyRunPublicForm, useDesignForm, useOrderForm hooks live in sibling files
each form component shrinks to ~300 lines of JSX plus onSubmit wiring
all existing tests pass

nodes.title: Design Page Motion and Polish
nodes.description: Deferred polish pass: tasteful motion, hover, transitions across the design page + editor. Starts with a human design discussion before implementation.
acceptanceCriteria: Human design direction agreed first (needs-human)
Motion/hover/transition polish applied; respects reduced-motion
No functional regressions

nodes.title: Wipe Stale Dev Design and Capture Track D Screenshots
nodes.description: One pre-D-01 design blocks the schema push, so snap.mjs has no backend: D-01/D-02/D-03 all shipped without screenshots. Wipe it, push, re-snap all three.
acceptanceCriteria: Stale designs row removed (human-approved) and npx convex dev --once pushes clean
snap.mjs captures /portal/designs/[id] and /admin/designs/[id] for D-01, D-02 and D-03
Obvious visual breakage found in those screenshots fixed or filed
docs/review/<nodeId>/ populated at 375/768/1280 light+dark
nodes.humanQuestion: May we delete the one pre-D-01 design on the dev deployment so the schema can push (screenshots are blocked for all of Track D)?

nodes.title: Run Surface Lock Controls
nodes.description: R-06 shipped lock/unlock mutations with no UI. The captain run surfaces (run setup, run responses) still offer Manage-run affordances on a locked run and expose no lock/unlock control, so a captain can neither lock deliberately nor see why a run stopped accepting edits.
acceptanceCriteria: captain/admin can lock a run from the run surface
a locked run shows a locked badge and read-only run settings
admin unlock (and pre-deadline captain unlock) is reachable from the UI

nodes.title: Jersey Breakdown Derivations + Order Detail Roster/Size View
nodes.description: Add lib/jerseyBreakdown.ts (pure derivations over listOrderEntries) and render collected jerseys as name/number/size per design on the order detail page, plus a combined size breakdown UI component. Foundation for the responses-page views.
acceptanceCriteria: lib/jerseyBreakdown.ts owns the roster-by-design + size-tally derivations
Order detail shows name/number/size per design via listOrderEntries
Combined size breakdown is a UI-only derived component
Per-design lines reconcile with countsByRun; no regressions

nodes.title: Captain Responses Page — Multi-View Breakdown (By Roster / By Fan)
nodes.description: Add a view switcher on the captain responses page over the same listOrderEntries data: By roster (reuses C-01) and By fan (email to ordered jerseys), plus the combined size breakdown. Adds only the jerseysByFan derivation.
acceptanceCriteria: Responses page has a By roster / By fan view switcher
By roster reuses C-01's per-design breakdown component
By fan groups by normalized submitter email to jersey lines
Existing detailed table remains; no regressions

nodes.title: Blank user name/email across admin surfaces
nodes.description: Admin Captain/Owner columns and customer names render blank; syncCurrentUser is gated behind getCurrentUser===null so existing rows never backfill, and the Clerk convex JWT template may not map name/email claims. Cosmetic fallbacks landed; real fix = populate the data.
acceptanceCriteria: Clerk convex JWT template confirmed to include name+email
Signed-in user's Convex row has name/email after login
Existing blank rows backfilled
Admin surfaces show real names

nodes.title: Portal pages flash 'not found' while auth loading
nodes.description: Owner-scoped queries (getMyOrder/getMyDesign/listMyDesigns) return null both for 'not found' and 'no authenticated user yet'; pages render null as a definitive not-found, so users flash 'Order not found' before the Clerk token attaches. Gate on Clerk isLoaded, or distinguish the two nulls server-side.
acceptanceCriteria: Auth-loading shows a loading state not not-found
Genuine missing/forbidden still shows not-found
Covers order detail, design detail, designs list
No flash on normal cold load for signed-in user

nodes.title: Unified Roster Read + Design-Card Roster Preview
nodes.description: Join rosterEntries with orderEntries into one per-design read (slots with their ordered sizes, plus blank/bulk lines) and put it on the order page's design cards. Fixes the defect where the order page reads order entries while Run Setup reads roster entries, so a seeded-but-unordered player is invisible. Foundation for the rest of Track M.
acceptanceCriteria: listForRun returns each slot with filled, collision, ordered sizes and total
Blank/bulk lines (no rosterEntryId) come back grouped per design
Pure derivation in lib/jerseyBreakdown.ts turns the read into per-design rows
Design cards show the roster with unfilled slots rendered muted
Preview is capped with an overflow count
Per-design totals still reconcile with orderEntries.countsByRun
Responses page (C-02) does not regress

nodes.title: Roster Sheet on Design Cards
nodes.description: Each design card gets a Manage roster button opening a Sheet with that design's full roster and inline add/edit/remove. Surfaces the collision flag listForRun already computes but the UI drops, and opens read-only for locked runs. RosterManager retires from Run Setup.
acceptanceCriteria: Manage roster button opens a Sheet scoped to one design
Add, edit, and remove slots inline with server errors surfaced as readable toasts
Collision flag surfaced on affected slots
Locked runs open the sheet read-only with a note
No run yet shows a hint, not a button; nothing creates a run implicitly
Usable at 375px with 15 rows
RosterManager removed from JerseyRunSetup
Fan-created slot behaviour unchanged

nodes.title: Bulk Paste Roster Import
nodes.description: Paste a roster straight out of Excel or Google Sheets into the roster sheet. A pure parser in lib/ handles TSV, CSV, and single-column trailing-number formats with per-row Name/Number order detection; a preview-and-confirm step flags duplicates and unparseable rows before a new createMany mutation commits the rest.
acceptanceCriteria: Pure DOM-free parser in lib/rosterEntry/
Accepts TSV, CSV, and single-column trailing number
Detects Name/Number column order per row via the numeric column
Rows validated with existing checkRosterName/checkRosterNumber
Preview flags existing, unparseable, and in-paste duplicate rows and excludes them
Nothing writes until confirm; button states the real count
createMany enforces ownership, lock, design-on-order, and a batch bound

nodes.title: Mirror Roster Between Designs
nodes.description: One-action mirror so a home/away kit is seeded once, not twice. From inside a design's roster sheet the captain picks another design in the order and copies its player slots across — names and numbers only, never sizes or order entries. Strictly additive, with silent skip on slots that already exist.
acceptanceCriteria: Pull-direction Copy roster from picker in the sheet, one source at a time
Copies name and number only, never sizes or order entries
Copied slots land as source captain and unfilled
Existing slots matched on normalized name and number are skipped silently
Result reported plainly, e.g. 18 copied, 2 already there
Purely additive: existing target slots, filled state, and order entries unchanged
copyToDesign rejects locked runs, foreign designs, non-owners, and same-design copies

nodes.title: Run Setup Slimming — Fixed Sizes, Names Mode Relocation, Start Collecting
nodes.description: Removes size choice entirely (fixed 8-size catalog, field retained and populated from the constant), relocates names mode to the order page where a fixed-mode design with no players can warn, and moves run creation to a Start collecting affordance taking only a deadline. /run/setup survives as management-only, with no lock control. The only M slice touching the public form — take it last.
acceptanceCriteria: jerseyRuns.create drops sizeOptions and populates all 8 sizes
Size picker gone; public form still offers all 8 and checkSize is unchanged
Pre-existing runs keep their narrower sizeOptions with no migration
New setNamesMode mutation, ownership-gated and locked-run-rejecting
Names mode lives on the order page and switches freely both directions, verified end-to-end on the public form
Fixed mode with zero slots warns inline, does not block
Start collecting on the order page takes only a deadline; nothing creates a run implicitly
/run/setup holds share link, deadline, custom questions, summary — no lock control

nodes.title: Run responses page hangs on loading when no run exists
nodes.description: app/portal/orders/[id]/run/responses gates its loading return on data === undefined, but data is skipped whenever unStub is null - so the NoRunYet branch below it is unreachable and a captain with no run yet sees an endless skeleton.
acceptanceCriteria: A captain opening /run/responses before any run exists sees the NoRunYet state, not a skeleton
A run that exists still renders its responses unchanged
Regression test covers the no-run-yet path

nodes.title: Populate user profiles on production Convex
nodes.description: Set CLERK_SECRET_KEY on the production Convex deployment and run the one-off users:backfillProfilesFromClerk so prod rows get real names, same as dev did in B-02.
acceptanceCriteria: CLERK_SECRET_KEY is set on the prod Convex deployment
npx convex run --prod users:backfillProfilesFromClerk reports 0 remaining blank rows
Admin surfaces on production show real captain/owner names
nodes.humanQuestion: Set CLERK_SECRET_KEY on prod Convex and run users:backfillProfilesFromClerk

nodes.title: Snap user cannot reach any /admin route
nodes.description: SNAP_UID (jcc@sidestep.design) is not an admin, so every /admin/* screenshot captures a 403 page. No admin UI can be reviewed from the loop until this account is granted admin.
acceptanceCriteria: The snap account can load /admin/* without a 403
node scripts/snap.mjs on an admin route produces a real page capture
nodes.humanQuestion: Grant the snap account admin (or point SNAP_UID at an admin) so /admin/* can be screenshotted

nodes.title: Snap account owns no orders, so no /portal/orders/* surface can be screenshotted
nodes.description: SNAP_UID (jcc@sidestep.design) owns zero orders on the dev deployment and /portal itself aborts under Playwright (net::ERR_ABORTED), so every /portal/orders/* capture comes back blank. Seed a dev order owned by the snap user (ideally one with a run and one without) and fix the /portal navigation abort.
acceptanceCriteria: SNAP_UID owns at least one dev order with a jersey run and one without
node scripts/snap.mjs on /portal and /portal/orders/<id>/run/responses produces non-blank captures
The no-run-yet state from B-04 is photographable
